mode: Window-free egui and lint checks only; no desktop/native-window, file-dialog or rendered-preview launches.
scope: Classic bounds the Drawing on label to one truncated line with one explicit full-name tooltip. Automatic elision tooltips are disabled on that label to prevent duplicates. Layer rows show hover feedback, a selected accent outline and a full-name tooltip. The host retains layer-identity capture and committed property-edit semantics.
checks: A new regression renames a real layer to 900 characters through the UI, at 1360x900 scale 1 light and 1100x500 scale 2 dark with repeated layout. Layer-name and opacity editors stay fixed and on-screen; the status stays one line. Selected metadata and painted accent outlines are inspected. Both row and status hover show exactly one full-name tooltip, with horizontal bounds checked. Hover and repeated frames preserve the post-rename document/history. Existing layer ordering, visibility, old-owner rename and undo tests remain passing.
limits: No layer thumbnails or additional layer operations are implemented. Studio retains its prior status-label behavior. This is headless geometry/interaction evidence, not native/rendered visual parity or latency qualification.
